mapper.select: select item_id as itemId, item_name as itemName, item_price as itemPrice, item_count as itemCount, item_pic as itemPic, item_comment as itemComment from item;
mapper.insert: insert into item (item_name, item_price, item_count, item_pic, item_comment) values (#{itemName}, #{itemPrice}, #{itemCount}, #{itemPic}, #{itemComment});
mapper.update: update item set item_name = #{itemName}, item_price = #{itemPrice}, item_count = #{itemCount}, item_pic = #{itemPic}, item_comment = #{itemComment} where item_id = #{itemId};
